name: STACK-16
description: A stack machine: no registers for the program to name. Every instruction takes its operands from the top of a data stack and leaves its result there, so ADD has no operands at all, and CALL and RET use a return stack of their own.
tagline: A stack machine with no registers to name

programs.name: Count down from 9
programs.description: A loop whose counter lives on the stack, copied with DUP

programs.name: The sum of 1 to 100
programs.description: Adds up 1 to 100 and prints 5050 with a print routine that calls itself
